method: Read pinned C++ source and reused original literal fixtures; no C++ execution and no native Rust output used as expected data. Custom toy examples use direct multinomial arithmetic. Tests have no .reference or /tmp runtime dependency.

source_cases.scope: Accessor consistency, not source literal configuration identities; native test additionally verifies descending probability from the header contract.

custom_natural_tables.source: ElementDB.cpp, lines 134-211; original decimal strings retained in the test
custom_natural_tables.mass_precision: Parse each source decimal as f64.
custom_natural_tables.probability_precision: Parse source decimal as f64, narrow to f32, widen to f64 to recreate the source ElementDB -> Peak1D -> custom vector path.
custom_natural_tables.zero_abundance: Natural tritium is omitted, matching the source formula adapter and source test setup.
custom_natural_tables.custom_insulin_note: Upstream asserts insulin formula-constructor counts; applying identical source natural tables through custom input is an independent adapter consistency check, not a separate upstream custom-insulin assertion.

comparison_policy.source_literals: IsoSpec_test.cpp my_real_similar: a*(1-1e-7)<=b<=a*(1+1e-7); no absolute floor. Fructose reference probabilities are stored f32 values.
comparison_policy.accessors: to_peak mass must equal raw mass; intensity must equal raw probability cast to f32. Raw probability agrees with exp(log_probability) at source relative tolerance.
comparison_policy.custom_toy: Mass absolute tolerance 1e-12, probability 1e-15, log probability 1e-14; no source tie order imposed.
comparison_policy.iterator_thresholds: Absolute thresholds compare returned raw f64 probability >= threshold. Relative thresholds compare raw probability / original-mode probability when both probabilities are finite and positive, otherwise use the canonical logarithmic cutoff. Relative values >1 exhaust immediately; zero allows remaining underflowed states. No epsilon is added: equality on returned values is retained and the next larger representable cutoff excludes that value.
comparison_policy.materializer_thresholds: FineIsotopePatternGenerator materialization retains its existing logarithmic threshold comparisons. Iterator raw-value boundaries are a separate explicit native policy, not a change to old materialized goldens.

independent_custom_cases.expectation: Raw probability and logarithm retain their strict order around 0.5; both stored f32 intensities are 0.5.

independent_custom_cases.derivation: Product of n=2 binomial probabilities [0.0625,0.375,0.5625] with the independent n=1 probabilities [0.6,0.4]. Equal-mass configurations are distinct.

boundaries.formula_charge: Raw wrapper formula adapter ignores charge; FineIsotopePatternGenerator separately adds positive natural H and rejects negative charge. Separate integration/adversarial tests cover this distinction.
boundaries.total_hint: Source total generator p is only a traversal hint and can continue to full support. No hint API or layer traversal is implemented or claimed by these tests.
boundaries.stream_state: Source current-state accessors are undefined before first successful advance and after false. Owning Rust values and fused exhaustion are explicit native safe contracts.
boundaries.thresholds: Consuming threshold methods filter the remaining stream against the original global mode. Iterator absolute/raw-ratio comparisons preserve returned-value equality, with a logarithmic fallback for nonpositive or nonfinite raw probabilities; relative >1 selects nothing. Materializers retain logarithmic comparisons. Exact boundary and deterministic tie policies are native; no backend equality/layer-order parity claim.
boundaries.untrimmed_coverage: Source untrimmed materializer and backend-dependent layer/pivot membership remain outside this increment.
boundaries.custom_validation: Source only checks outer lengths and probabilities >0; native checked shape, finite-value and resource limits are deliberate safety behavior, documented in support API.
